description: This file contains unit tests for the Jaav class Obs, covering various functionalities such as group management, value handling, dirty state detection, and copying. It also tests behavior related to complex concepts, interpretation, and form fields within the OpenMRS core project.

classes.name: ObsTest
classes.description: Test suite for the Obs class, covering various behaviors including group management, value parsing, dirty state toggling, copying, and interpretation.

methods.name: shouldAddandRemoveObsToGroup
methods.description: Tests adding and removing observations from groups, including duplicate handling and self-addition prevention.

methods.name: shouldGetRelatedObservations
methods.description: Tests retrieval of related observations from hierarchical groupings.

methods.name: isComplex_shouldReturnTrueIfTheConceptIsComplex
methods.description: Checks if an observation is identified as complex based on its concept datatype.

methods.name: setValueAsString_shouldFailIfTheValueOfTheStringIsEmpty
methods.description: Verifies that setting an empty string as value throws an exception.

methods.name: setValueAsString_shouldFailIfTheValueOfTheStringIsNull
methods.description: Verifies that setting null as value throws an exception.

methods.name: setValueAsString_shouldNotFailIfTheValueOfTheStringIsBlankAndTypeIsST
methods.description: Checks that blank string input for string-type concepts is accepted.

methods.name: setValueAsString_shouldFailIfTheValueOfTheStringIsBlankAndTypeIsNotST
methods.description: Ensures that blank string input for non-string concepts throws an exception.

methods.name: getValueAsBoolean_shouldReturnFalseForValue_numericConceptsIfValueIs0
methods.description: Returns false when numeric value is zero.

methods.name: getValueAsBoolean_shouldReturnNullForValue_numericConceptsIfValueIsNeither1Nor0
methods.description: Returns null for numeric values other than 0 or 1.

methods.name: getValueAsString_shouldReturnNonPreciseValuesForNumericConcepts
methods.description: Validates string conversion for numeric concepts with no decimal allowance.

methods.name: getValueAsString_shouldNotReturnLongDecimalNumbersAsScientificNotation
methods.description: Ensures large numeric values are represented in standard decimal notation.

methods.name: getValueAsString_shouldReturnDateInCorrectFormat
methods.description: Checks date formatting in string output.

methods.name: getValueAsBoolean_shouldReturnTrueForValue_numericConceptsIfValueIs1
methods.description: Returns true when numeric value is 1.

methods.name: getGroupMembers_shouldGetAllGroupMembersIfPassedTrueAndNonvoidedIfPassedFalse
methods.description: Tests retrieval of group members, including filtering voided observations.

methods.name: hasGroupMembers_shouldReturnTrueIfThisObsHasGroupMembersBasedOnParameter
methods.description: Checks whether an observation has group members based on voided status.

methods.name: isObsGrouping_shouldIncludeVoidedObs
methods.description: Validates inclusion of voided observations in group check.

methods.name: getValueAsString_shouldUseCommasOrDecimalPlacesDependingOnLocale
methods.description: Tests locale-aware numeric formatting.

methods.name: getValueAsString_shouldNotUseThousandSeparator
methods.description: Verifies that thousand separators are excluded from string output.

methods.name: getValueAsString_shouldReturnRegularNumberForSizeOfZeroToOrGreaterThanTenDigits
methods.description: Tests representation of large numbers.

methods.name: getValueAsString_shouldReturnRegularNumberIfDecimalPlacesAreAsHighAsSix
methods.description: Checks decimal precision in string output.

methods.name: getValueAsString_shouldReturnLocalizedCodedConcept
methods.description: Ensures coded concept values are localized correctly.

methods.name: isDirty_shouldReturnFalseWhenNoChangeHasBeenMade
methods.description: Confirms that unmodified observations are clean.

methods.name: isDirty_shouldReturnTrueWhenAnyImmutableFieldHasBeenChangedForEditedObs
methods.description: Checks that changes to immutable fields mark the observation as dirty.

methods.name: isDirty_shouldReturnFalseWhenAnyImmutableFieldHasBeenChangedForNewObs
methods.description: Ensures that new, uninitialized observations do not become dirty upon setting fields identical to defaults.

methods.name: updateImmutableFieldsAndAssert
methods.description: Helper method to mutate fields and verify dirty flag behavior.

methods.name: isDirty_shouldReturnFalseWhenOnlyMutableFieldsAreChanged
methods.description: Confirms that mutable field changes do not mark object as dirty.

methods.name: isDirty_shouldReturnTrueWhenAnImmutableFieldIsChangedFromANonNullToANullValueForEditedObs
methods.description: Detects dirtiness when immutable field changes from set to null.

methods.name: isDirty_shouldReturnFalsWhenAnImmutableFieldIsChangedFromANonNullToANullValueForNewObs
methods.description: Verifies no dirtiness for new observations when resetting fields to null.

methods.name: isDirty_shouldReturnTrueWhenAnImmutableFieldIsChangedFromANullToANonNullValueInExistingObs
methods.description: Flags dirtiness when null-to-nonnull change occurs in existing observation.

methods.name: isDirty_shouldReturnFalseWhenAnImmutableFieldIsChangedFromANullToANonNullValueInNewObs
methods.description: Ensures that new observations with null-to-nonnull changes are not marked dirty.

methods.name: setFormField_shouldNotMarkTheObsAsDirtyWhenTheValueHasNotBeenChanged
methods.description: Checks idempotency of setting form fields.

methods.name: setFormField_shouldMarkTheObsAsDirtyWhenTheValueHasBeenChanged
methods.description: Verifies that changes to form fields mark the object as dirty.

methods.name: setFormField_shouldMarkTheObsAsDirtyWhenTheValueIsChangedFromANonNullToANullValue
methods.description: Detects dirtiness when null is set over a nonnull value.

methods.name: setFormField_shouldMarkTheObsAsDirtyWhenTheValueIsChangedFromANullToANonNullValue
methods.description: Detects dirtiness when nonnull value is set over null.

methods.name: addGroupMember_shouldReturnFalseWhenADuplicateObsIsAddedAsAMember
methods.description: Ensures no duplicates are added to groups.

methods.name: removeGroupMember_shouldReturnFalseWhenANonExistentObsIsRemoved
methods.description: Handles removal of non-group members gracefully.

methods.name: removeGroupMember_shouldReturnDirtyFalseWhenAnObsIsRemoved
methods.description: Ensures removal resets dirty flag appropriately.

methods.name: setGroupMembers_shouldNotMarkTheExistingObsAsDirtyWhenTheSetIsChangedFromNullToANonEmptyOne
methods.description: Checks that setting group members from null is non-dirty.

methods.name: setGroupMembers_shouldNotMarkNewObsAsDirtyWhenTheSetIsChangedFromNullToANonEmptyOne
methods.description: Same check for newly created observations.

methods.name: setGroupMembers_shouldNotMarkTheExistingObsAsDirtyWhenTheSetIsReplacedWithAnotherWithDifferentMembers
methods.description: Verifies that replacing group members with a different set is non-dirty.

methods.name: setGroupMembers_shouldNotMarkTheNewObsAsDirtyWhenTheSetIsReplacedWithAnotherWithDifferentMembers
methods.description: Same for new observations.

methods.name: setGroupMembers_shouldNotMarkTheObsAsDirtyWhenTheSetIsChangedFromNullToAnEmptyOne
methods.description: Empty set assignment does not dirty.

methods.name: setGroupMembers_shouldNotMarkTheObsAsDirtyWhenTheSetIsReplacedWithAnotherWithSameMembers
methods.description: No dirty flag change when the same set is reassigned.

methods.name: setObsDateTime_shouldNotMarkTheObsAsDirtyWhenDateIsNotChangedAndExistingValueIsOfTimeStampType
methods.description: Handles set with timestamp to date without marking dirty.

methods.name: shouldSetFinalStatusOnNewObsByDefault
methods.description: Checks that default status is FINAL.

methods.name: newInstance_shouldCopyMostFields
methods.description: Tests deep copying of an observation, ensuring most fields are duplicated correctly.

methods.name: shouldSupportInterpretationProperty
methods.description: Tests getter and setter for interpretation property.

methods.name: setValueBoolean_shouldNotSetValueForNonBooleanConcept
methods.description: Ensures boolean setter does not alter non-boolean concepts.
